content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QS Column 9

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 9:1 | "they-shall-be-governed by the-first regulations" | "shall be governed by the first regulations" | "must live by the original rules" | Word choice | LOGOS — "regulations" preserves mishpatim; "rules" (PNEUMA) is too informal |
| 2 | 9:2 | "the-Messiahs-of Aaron and Israel" | "the Messiahs of Aaron and Israel" | "the Anointed Ones of Aaron and Israel" | Theology | LOGOS — "Messiahs" preserves the Hebrew mashiach and is the standard scholarly rendering of this famous passage |
| 3 | 9:3 | "the-statutes for the-Instructor" | "the statutes for the Instructor" | "the guidelines for the Instructor" | Word choice | LOGOS — "statutes" preserves chuqqim; "guidelines" is too weak for legal terminology |
| 4 | 9:3-4 | "with every living-being, according-to the-regulation-of every time and according-to the-weight-of every man" | "with every living being, according to the regulation of every time and the weight of every man" | "with every person, adapted to the demands of each season and the character of each individual" | Interpretation | LOGOS — "regulation of every time" and "weight of every man" preserve the Hebrew idioms; PNEUMA's "demands of each season" and "character" are interpretive |
| 5 | 9:6 | "the-Sons-of-Righteousness" | "the Sons of Righteousness" | "the righteous" | Terminology | LOGOS — "Sons of Righteousness" is a sectarian title and should be capitalized as such |
| 6 | 9:8-9 | "according-to the-cleanness-of his hands" | "according to the cleanness of his hands" | "by the integrity of his actions" | Idiom | LOGOS — "cleanness of his hands" preserves the Hebrew metaphor; PNEUMA abstracts it |
| 7 | 9:9-10 | "the-men-of the-pit" | "the men of the pit" | "those who are destined for destruction" | Terminology | LOGOS — "men of the pit" is the standard DSS rendering of anshei ha-shachat |
| 8 | 9:10 | "he-shall-conceal the-counsel-of the-Torah in-the-midst-of the-men-of injustice" | "shall conceal the counsel of the Torah among the men of injustice" | "must keep the Torah's counsel hidden from those who practice injustice" | Preposition | LOGOS — "among" preserves betokh (in the midst of); PNEUMA's "from" changes the meaning subtly |
| 9 | 9:12-13 | "the-mysteries-of wonder and truth" | "the mysteries of wonder and truth" | "the astonishing mysteries of God's truth" | Expansion | LOGOS — PNEUMA adds "God's" and converts "wonder" to an adjective; the Hebrew has two coordinate nouns |
| 10 | 9:13 | "they-may-walk perfectly, each-man with his neighbor" | "they may walk perfectly, each with his neighbor" | "they may live in harmony with one another" | Interpretation | LOGOS — "walk perfectly" preserves the Hebrew idiom halakh tamim; PNEUMA's "live in harmony" is a gloss |
| 11 | 9:14-15 | "the-time for-the-clearing-of the-way to the-wilderness" | "the time for clearing the way to the wilderness" | "the season for preparing the road to the wilderness" | Word choice | LOGOS — "clearing" is closer to the Hebrew; "preparing the road" (PNEUMA) echoes Isaiah differently |
| 12 | 9:17 | "the-regulations-of the-way for the-Instructor in these times, for his loving and for his hating" | "the regulations of the way for the Instructor in these times, for his loving and for his hating" | "the principles the Instructor must follow in this age, governing both whom he loves and whom he rejects" | Interpretation | LOGOS — "for his loving and for his hating" preserves the stark Hebrew dualism; PNEUMA softens "hating" to "rejects" |
| 13 | 9:18 | "eternal hatred for the-men-of the-pit in a spirit-of concealment" | "eternal hatred for the men of the pit in a spirit of secrecy" | "unrelenting opposition to the people of destruction, carried out in secret" | Word choice | LOGOS — "eternal hatred" and "spirit of secrecy" are precise; PNEUMA softens "hatred" to "opposition" and "men of the pit" to "people of destruction" |
| 14 | 9:18-19 | "to-leave to-them property and the-labor-of hands like a slave to the-one-who-rules over-him" | "leaving to them property and the labor of hands as a slave to his ruler" | "leaving them material goods and manual labor like a servant to his master" | Word choice | LOGOS — "slave" is closer to Hebrew 'eved than "servant"; "ruler" preserves moshel |
| 15 | 9:20 | "a zealot for the-statute and its time, for the-day-of vengeance" | "zealous for the statute and its time, for the day of vengeance" | "passionate about the law and its appointed seasons, ready for the day of reckoning" | Word choice | LOGOS — "zealous" and "vengeance" are precise; "passionate" (PNEUMA) is too emotional, "reckoning" too abstract |
| 16 | 9:22-23 | "apart-from the-will-of God nothing shall-please-him" | "apart from the will of God nothing shall give him pleasure" | "nothing apart from God's will should give him satisfaction" | Structure | LOGOS — preserves Hebrew word order placing the qualifier first for emphasis |
| 17 | 9:25-26 | "he-shall-recount his-covenant-faithfulness" | "he shall recount his covenant-faithfulness" | "he must celebrate God's faithful love" | Terminology | LOGOS — "covenant-faithfulness" is the project rendering for hesed; PNEUMA's "faithful love" departs from convention |
| 18 | 9:26 | "in the-endurance-of affliction he-shall-bless him" | "amid the endurance of affliction he shall bless him" | "even while enduring suffering he must offer praise" | Word choice | LOGOS — "affliction" preserves the Hebrew; "suffering" (PNEUMA) is more generic |
